sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [Eb7]I shall see [Ab]the King where the angels sing, I shall see the King some day,
[Ab]In the better land, on that golden strand, And with Him shall ever stay.
[Ab]In His glory, [Eb7/Bb]I shall see the King, And forever endless praises sing;
[Ab]'Twas on Calvary Jesus died for me; I shall see the King someday.

sections.name: Refrain
lines: [Ab]In His glory, [Eb7/Bb]I shall see the King,
[Ab]'Twas on Calvary Jesus died for me;

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [Eb7]In the [Ab]land of song, in the glory throng,
[Ab]With my [Eb7/Bb]Lord once slain I shall ever reign

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [Eb7]I shall [Ab]see the King, all my tributes bring,
[Ab]Then my [Eb7/Bb]song shall be how He ransomed me
[Ab]And has kept me by His grace.
